import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import re
import os
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

def make_id(row):
    return f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}"

train_df["id"] = train_df.apply(make_id, axis=1)
test_df["id"] = test_df.apply(make_id, axis=1)

# Split into train/validation BEFORE any model work
val_ratio = 0.15
X_raw_train, X_val, y_raw_train, y_val_ids, ids_train, ids_val = train_test_split(
    train_df.drop(columns=['after']).reset_index(drop=True),
    train_df[['after']].reset_index(drop=True),
    test_size=val_ratio,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df['class'] if 'class' in train_df.columns else None,
)

X_train_full = X_raw_train.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
y_train_enc = X_val['after'].values
y_val_enc = y_raw_train['after'].values
ids_train_full = ids_train.values

print(f"Training size: {len(X_train_full)}")
print(f"Validation size: {len(X_val)}")

def extract_features_fast(df_text_col, df_id_col, target_col=None):
    before = df_text_col['before'].fillna('').astype(str).values
    ids = df_id_col.astype(str).values
    
    feat_arr = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_len = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_num = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_alpha = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_punct_any = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_start_punct = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_end_punct = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_word_pattern = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_short = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_long = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_rus_start = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_rus_vowels = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_space = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_self = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_sil = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_one_char = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_lt5 = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_ge5 = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_nonempty = np.zeros(len(before))
    feat_mod10 = np.zeros(len(before))
    
    len_vals = []
    for i, b in enumerate(before):
        b_clean = b.strip()
        l = len(b_clean)
        len_vals.append(l)
        
        feat_len[i] = min(l, 100) / 100.0
        feat_num[i] = 1 if re.match(r"^\d+$", b) else 0
        feat_alpha[i] = 1 if b.isalpha() else 0
        feat_punct_any[i] = 1 if any(not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace() for c in b) else 0
        feat_start_punct[i] = 1 if b.startswith(tuple(".,:;?!-")) else 0
        feat_end_punct[i] = 1 if b.endswith(tuple(".,:;?!-")) else 0
        feat_word_pattern[i] = 1 if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$", b) else 0
        feat_short[i] = 1 if len(b_clean) <= 3 else 0
        feat_long[i] = 1 if len(b_clean) > 3 else 0
        
        if b:
            feat_rus_start[i] = 1 if b.lower().startswith("в") or b.lower().endswith("е") else 0
            feat_rus_vowels[i] = 1 if any(c in "аеёиоуыэюяАЕЁИОУЫЭЮЯ" for c in b) else 0
        feat_space[i] = 1 if b.isspace() else 0
        feat_self[i] = 1 if b == "<self>" else 0
        feat_sil[i] = 1 if b == "<sil>" else 0
        feat_one_char[i] = 1 if len(b_clean) == 1 else 0
        feat_lt5[i] = 1 if len(b_clean) < 5 else 0
        feat_ge5[i] = 1 if len(b_clean) >= 5 else 0
        feat_nonempty[i] = 1 if b_strip := b.strip() else 0
        feat_mod10[i] = int(len(b)) % 10
    
    feat_len = np.array(len_vals)
    feat_arr = np.column_stack([feat_len, feat_num, feat_alpha, feat_punct_any, 
                                 feat_start_punct, feat_end_punct, feat_word_pattern,
                                 feat_short, feat_long, feat_rus_start, feat_rus_vowels,
                                 feat_space, feat_self, feat_sil, feat_one_char, 
                                 feat_lt5, feat_ge5, feat_nonempty, feat_mod10])
    return feat_arr, ids

print("\nExtracting features...")
print("Training features...")
X_feat_train, ids_train_feat = extract_features_fast(X_train_full, train_df['id'])
y_train_enc = X_train_full['after'].values

print("Validation features...")
X_feat_val, ids_val_feat = extract_features_fast(X_val, test_df['id'][:len(X_val)])

print("\nFitting Random Forest...")
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight='balanced',
    verbose=False,
    max_features='sqrt'
)

model.fit(X_feat_train, y_train_enc)

print("\nValidating on hold-out set...")
val_preds = model.predict(X_feat_val)

accuracy = sum(1 for pred, actual in zip(val_preds, y_val_enc) if pred == actual) / len(val_preds)

print(f"\n=== VALIDATION METRICS ===")
correct_count = sum(1 for pred, actual in zip(val_preds, y_val_enc) if pred == actual)
total_count = len(val_preds)
print(f"Validation samples: {total_count}")
print(f"Correct predictions: {correct_count}")
print(f"Sequence accuracy (exact match): {accuracy:.6f}")

print("\nPredicting on test set...")
X_feat_test, ids_test_feat = extract_features_fast(test_df, test_df['id'])
test_predictions = model.predict(X_feat_test)

print("Creating submission file...")
submissions = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": ids_test_feat,
    "after": test_predictions
})
submissions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submissions)} rows")
